---
title: "Install required R packages"
output: html_notebook
---

Run independently before the analysis. This notebook does not allocate a research run increment.


## Check dependencies

Installs packages for temporal prediction, survey inference, and the class-aligned optional PCA exercise. No model is fitted.

```{r check-dependencies}
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Required packages
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Dependency list
packages <- c(
    "data.table",
    "ggplot2",
    "glmnet",
    "ranger",
    "Matrix",
    "survey",
    "rmarkdown",
    "knitr",
    "cluster",
    "scales"
)


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dependency check
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Checks whether each package namespace can be loaded without attaching
# the package to the search path.
# vapply() returns one logical value per package. Negating those results
# selects the packages that are unavailable.
missing <- packages[
    !vapply(
        packages,
        requireNamespace,
        logical(1),
        quietly = TRUE
    )
]


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Install missing dependencies
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Installs only unavailable packages, leaving available packages unchanged.
# An explicit repository used for consistency.
if (length(missing)) {
    install.packages(
        missing,
        repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org"
    )
}


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Completion message
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Notes completion of the check-and-install step.
cat("[PACKAGES] Package check complete.\n")
```
